dialogues.jp: 「くあっ、かったる」
dialogues.en: "Gwa, I'm in trouble!"
dialogues.text: "Gwa, I'm in trouble!"

dialogues.jp:
部活に入っていない人間が朝からランニングを
するというのは、あまり気持ちのいいものでは
ない。
dialogues.en:
I don't understand how people in club activities or whatnot
can run every morning so faithfully.
dialogues.text:
I don't understand how people in club activities or whatnot
can run every morning so faithfully.

dialogues.jp:
ましてや、遅刻という時間制限があるのなら、
なおさらだろう。
dialogues.en: Maybe they're as motivated to do so as I am right now...
dialogues.text: Maybe they're as motivated to do so as I am right now...

dialogues.jp:
「やっぱり深夜映画を最後まで観てしまったの
　が敗因か」
dialogues.en: "Guess watching that late-night movie did me in..."
dialogues.text: "Guess watching that late-night movie did me in..."

dialogues.jp: 走りながら、ちょっと反省してみる。
dialogues.en: A little running, a little reflection.
dialogues.text: A little running, a little reflection.

dialogues.jp:
途中で録画して、さっさと眠っちまえばよかっ
たんだよな。と、気づいても後の祭りである。
dialogues.en:
I should've just taped it and went to bed. But there's no
point crying over spilt milk.
dialogues.text:
I should've just taped it and went to bed. But there's no
point crying over spilt milk.

dialogues.jp:
それにしても、頼みの綱だった目覚ましに裏切
られるとは予想外だった。
dialogues.en:
Especially since in the beginning, I should've asked Nemu to
wake me up as well...
dialogues.text:
Especially since in the beginning, I should've asked Nemu to
wake me up as well...

dialogues.jp: （まさか電池が切れていたとは……）
dialogues.en:
My neck bounced up and down from the running as I continued
thinking.
dialogues.text:
My neck bounced up and down from the running as I continued
thinking.

dialogues.jp:
これなら最初から音夢に起こしてくれと頼んで
おくべきだったかな。
dialogues.en:
"On second thought, if I actually asked her to wake me up, I
don't want to know WHAT she'd come up with..."
dialogues.text:
"On second thought, if I actually asked her to wake me up, I
don't want to know WHAT she'd come up with..."

dialogues.jp: そう思いかけて、俺は首をぶるぶると振った。
dialogues.en:
Even a telephone book or an encyclopedia, in her hands, can
quickly become a weapon of mass destruction.
dialogues.text:
Even a telephone book or an encyclopedia, in her hands, can
quickly become a weapon of mass destruction.

dialogues.jp:
「いやいや、あいつに頼むと、起こされ方が恐
　いからな」
dialogues.en: I take a quick check of the time on my wristwatch.
dialogues.text: I take a quick check of the time on my wristwatch.

dialogues.jp:
朝っぱらから、電話帳とか百科事典とか、一歩
間違えれば凶器になりかねん物が、降ってくる
のはたまらん。
dialogues.en: "Damnit, I'm definitely going to be late now."
dialogues.text: "Damnit, I'm definitely going to be late now."

dialogues.jp: 俺は腕の時計を見た。
dialogues.en: I grit my teeth, and hit the switch.
dialogues.text: I grit my teeth, and hit the switch.

dialogues.jp: 「いかん。完全に遅刻っぽいぞ」
dialogues.en: But, the accelerator of my body didn't work.
dialogues.text: But, the accelerator of my body didn't work.

dialogues.jp: 奥歯をぐっと噛みしめ、スイッチを押す。
dialogues.en: "(I can't forget this technique from my criminal days!)"
dialogues.text: "(I can't forget this technique from my criminal days!)"

dialogues.jp:
が、俺の身体に仕組まれている加速装置は作動
しなかった。
dialogues.en:
Making a little joke to myself, I continue my battle against
the clock.
dialogues.text:
Making a little joke to myself, I continue my battle against
the clock.

dialogues.jp:
（当然だな。どこぞの犯罪組織に改造された覚
　えはないんだから）
dialogues.en: Wait a minute, crap!
dialogues.text: Wait a minute, crap!

dialogues.jp:
ちょっとしたジョークが、自らをさらに厳しい
状況に追いやる。
dialogues.en:
I can't even be one minute late. Nemu's on the discplinary
committee.
dialogues.text:
I can't even be one minute late. Nemu's on the discplinary
committee.

dialogues.jp: マジ、ヤバ！
dialogues.en:
If I don't want to know what she'd come up with for waking
me up, what about when she actually has a reason to punish
me?
dialogues.text:
If I don't want to know what she'd come up with for waking
me up, what about when she actually has a reason to punish
me?

dialogues.jp:
気持ち的には、遅刻なんて一向に構わない。音
夢が風紀委員でなければ、だ。
dialogues.en: I pushed my running speed limit even further.
dialogues.text: I pushed my running speed limit even further.

dialogues.jp:
兄貴が早々遅刻ばかりしていては、音夢もバツ
が悪いだろうし、何より後で小言をちくちくと
言われるのがツラい。
dialogues.en: "Haah, haah, I can't take much more of this..."
dialogues.text: "Haah, haah, I can't take much more of this..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は可能な限り足を早めた。
dialogues.en:
But as I thought this, I could see the entrance of the
school, and my hopes raised.
dialogues.text:
But as I thought this, I could see the entrance of the
school, and my hopes raised.

dialogues.jp: 「ぜえっ、ぜえっ、もうダメだ」
dialogues.en: I take a large breath, and get ready for the final spurt.
dialogues.text: I take a large breath, and get ready for the final spurt.

dialogues.jp:
と思ったら、校門が見えてきた。ちょっとだけ
希望が湧いてくる。
dialogues.en: "Ohhhh! I'm going to make it!"
dialogues.text: "Ohhhh! I'm going to make it!"

dialogues.jp:
息は上がっているが、なんとか最後のスパート
はかけられそうだ。
dialogues.en: Like a racehorse, I dash madly towards the goal.
dialogues.text: Like a racehorse, I dash madly towards the goal.

dialogues.jp: 「ぬおおっ！　間に合え！」
dialogues.en: And then--
dialogues.text: And then--

dialogues.jp: ゴールに向かって、競走馬のように走り出す。
dialogues.en: "...What the"
dialogues.text: "...What the"

dialogues.jp: その時──。
dialogues.en:
From the corner of my eye, I can see a white, 4-legged
living object.
dialogues.text:
From the corner of my eye, I can see a white, 4-legged
living object.

dialogues.en:
It definitely isn't a cat or a dog. In fact, it looks more
like...
dialogues.text:
It definitely isn't a cat or a dog. In fact, it looks more
like...

dialogues.jp:
俺の視界の片隅に、白い四足の生き物が目に入っ
た。
dialogues.en: --A goat.
dialogues.text: --A goat.

dialogues.jp:
犬やネコなら気にも留めないだろうが、そこに
いたのは……。
dialogues.en: I exchange stares with the goat.
dialogues.text: I exchange stares with the goat.

dialogues.jp: ──ヤギだった。
dialogues.en:
It's eyes look just like the kind one would find in a "How
to draw demons" artbook.
dialogues.text:
It's eyes look just like the kind one would find in a "How
to draw demons" artbook.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、つい、そのヤギと見つめ合ってしまった。
dialogues.en: The kind of eerie eyes which scorn all of humanity.
dialogues.text: The kind of eerie eyes which scorn all of humanity.

dialogues.jp:
あの黒目が横になっている、悪魔の辞典の表紙
に描かれていそうな、あの特徴的な目だ。
dialogues.en: The ones which are staring at me right now.
dialogues.text: The ones which are staring at me right now.

dialogues.jp: 人類全体を蔑んでいそうな、あの不気味な瞳。
dialogues.en: This must be the pet of Satan himself...
dialogues.text: This must be the pet of Satan himself...

dialogues.jp: ヤギも俺の方をじーっと見つめていた。
dialogues.en: ──Bam!
dialogues.text: ──Bam!

dialogues.jp: ｛サタン／悪魔｝の使いがなぜ、こんなところに……。
dialogues.en: All of a sudden, something crashed into my back.
dialogues.text: All of a sudden, something crashed into my back.

dialogues.jp: ──ドスンっ！
dialogues.en: "Whoaaa!"
dialogues.text: "Whoaaa!"

dialogues.jp:
背中に強い衝撃があったのは、まさにその瞬間
だった。
dialogues.en: I tumble ungracefully forward, from the impact behind me.
dialogues.text: I tumble ungracefully forward, from the impact behind me.

dialogues.jp: 「のわあッ！」
dialogues.en:
Since whatever crashed into me screamed, I guess it was
probably a human.
dialogues.text:
Since whatever crashed into me screamed, I guess it was
probably a human.

dialogues.jp:
予期せぬ方向からの衝撃で、俺は無様にも転倒
していた。
dialogues.en: "W, who's that? Tackling me so early in the morning..."
dialogues.text: "W, who's that? Tackling me so early in the morning..."

dialogues.jp:
悲鳴があがったということは、つまり人間がぶ
つかってきたということだ。
dialogues.en:
Dusting the dirt off my school uniform, I quickly looked
around.
dialogues.text:
Dusting the dirt off my school uniform, I quickly looked
around.

dialogues.jp: 「だ、誰だ？　朝からタックルかます奴は……」
dialogues.en:
I found a girl on all fours, feverishly sweeping her hands
across the ground, looking for something.
dialogues.text:
I found a girl on all fours, feverishly sweeping her hands
across the ground, looking for something.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、制服の砂埃を払いながら、辺りを見回す。
dialogues.en:
A pitiful voice, with a traditional Kansai accent, emnated
from the girl.
dialogues.text:
A pitiful voice, with a traditional Kansai accent, emnated
from the girl.

dialogues.jp:
見ると、女の子が四つんばいになって、あたふ
たしながら地面をまさぐっている。
dialogues.en: Looks like this girl was the one who tackled me.
dialogues.text: Looks like this girl was the one who tackled me.

dialogues.jp:
まるで、伝説の関西芸人のような、情けない声
を出している女の子に駆け寄る。
dialogues.en: "Sorry, are you hurt?"
dialogues.text: "Sorry, are you hurt?"

dialogues.jp:
どうやら、タックルしてきたのは、この子らし
い。
dialogues.en:
I look around, and see a pair of glasses lying not too far
away from the girl.
dialogues.text:
I look around, and see a pair of glasses lying not too far
away from the girl.

dialogues.jp: 「悪りぃ、ケガはない？」
dialogues.en:
I pick up the glasses, which have a very chic and
old-fashioned feel to them.
dialogues.text:
I pick up the glasses, which have a very chic and
old-fashioned feel to them.

dialogues.jp:
周りを見回すと、女の子からさほど離れていな
い所に眼鏡が落ちていた。
dialogues.en: Good, the lens aren't damaged. The frame's okay too.
dialogues.text: Good, the lens aren't damaged. The frame's okay too.

dialogues.jp:
拾い上げると、今時珍しいぐらいシックな眼鏡
だった。
dialogues.en: "Are these glasses yours?"
dialogues.text: "Are these glasses yours?"

dialogues.jp:
よし、レンズは割れていない。フレームも大丈
夫だ。
dialogues.en: The girl took the glasses, and gave a deep bow to me.
dialogues.text: The girl took the glasses, and gave a deep bow to me.

dialogues.jp: 「メガネ、これだよね？」
dialogues.en:
The girl put on her glasses, and finally got a proper look
at me.
dialogues.text:
The girl put on her glasses, and finally got a proper look
at me.

dialogues.jp:
女の子は、メガネを受け取りながら、ぺこりと
頭をさげる。
dialogues.en:
The girls arms waved around wildly, as she jumped a step
back.
dialogues.text:
The girls arms waved around wildly, as she jumped a step
back.

dialogues.jp: そして、メガネをかけて、俺を見た瞬間、
dialogues.en: "W, What?!"
dialogues.text: "W, What?!"

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「うひゃおぅ！　お、男の人！」
dialogues.en: "...Ehh, could you be the person I ran into just now?"
dialogues.text: "...Ehh, could you be the person I ran into just now?"

dialogues.jp:
女の子は、手をばたばたと動かしながら、一歩
飛び退く。
dialogues.en: "More or less, I think I'm that person too."
dialogues.text: "More or less, I think I'm that person too."

dialogues.jp: 「えっ、えっ！」
dialogues.en: "No, it's okay. I know it wasn't on purpose."
dialogues.text: "No, it's okay. I know it wasn't on purpose."

dialogues.jp:
だいたい、あんなところにヤギなんて、いなけ
ればこんなことには、ならなかったのに！
dialogues.en:
And it's all that goat's fault anyway. If it wasn't there,
this wouldn't have happened at all!
dialogues.text:
And it's all that goat's fault anyway. If it wasn't there,
this wouldn't have happened at all!

dialogues.jp: ──そういや、さっきのヤギは……。
dialogues.en: --Speaking of that, where DID that goat go?
dialogues.text: --Speaking of that, where DID that goat go?

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp:
「ひゃうううう！　やーめーてー！　それを食
　べないでーーー！！！」
dialogues.en: "Gyaaaah! Stooooop! You can't eat THAT!"
dialogues.text: "Gyaaaah! Stooooop! You can't eat THAT!"

dialogues.jp: 悲鳴が聞こえる。ついでにヤギも発見。
dialogues.en:
Following the source of the shriek, I find the goat's
location.
dialogues.text:
Following the source of the shriek, I find the goat's
location.

dialogues.jp:
さっきの女の子が、道ばたにいたヤギに向かっ
て何か叫んでいた。
dialogues.en:
The girl from earlier was yelling at the goat further down
the road.
dialogues.text:
The girl from earlier was yelling at the goat further down
the road.

dialogues.jp: ヤギは、何かをもっしゃもっしゃと食べていた。
dialogues.en: The goat was chewing on something.
dialogues.text: The goat was chewing on something.

dialogues.jp: どうやらそれは紙のようだった。
dialogues.en: It looked like some paper.
dialogues.text: It looked like some paper.

dialogues.jp: Ｂ４サイズぐらいの。
dialogues.en: Roughly B-4 size.
dialogues.text: Roughly B-4 size.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp:
「おーねーがーいーだーかーらー！　食べない
　でー！　私の、汗と、涙と、その他いろんな
　ものの結晶をぉぉゥ！」
dialogues.en:
"P-l-e-a-s-e already! Stop eating it! That's the form of all
my blood, sweat and teaaaars!!"
dialogues.text:
"P-l-e-a-s-e already! Stop eating it! That's the form of all
my blood, sweat and teaaaars!!"

dialogues.jp:
女の子は、その紙を掴んで、必死で引っ張るが、
ヤギは生きたシュレッダーと化していた。
dialogues.en:
The girl was desperately pulling the paper away from the
goat-cum-paper shredder.
dialogues.text:
The girl was desperately pulling the paper away from the
goat-cum-paper shredder.

dialogues.jp:
無表情のまま、次々と紙をくわえ、無情にも飲
みこんでいく。
dialogues.en:
Not that it cared of course. The demon continued eating
away, page by page, ruthlessly at the paper, expressionless.
dialogues.text:
Not that it cared of course. The demon continued eating
away, page by page, ruthlessly at the paper, expressionless.

dialogues.jp: もっしゃもっしゃと食べていく。
dialogues.en:
I could hear the disgusting sounds of the paper being chewed
up inside it's mouth.
dialogues.text:
I could hear the disgusting sounds of the paper being chewed
up inside it's mouth.

dialogues.jp: 紙質も大きさもまったくお構いなし。
dialogues.en:
I doubt the quality of the paper, or what's on it, matters
to the demon goat one bit.
dialogues.text:
I doubt the quality of the paper, or what's on it, matters
to the demon goat one bit.

dialogues.jp:
動物大好きドリトル先生でもこいつを止めるこ
とは不可能だろう、つーぐらい男らしい食いっ
ぷりだ。
dialogues.en:
Not even Dr. Dolittle would be able to stop this monster
now.
dialogues.text:
Not even Dr. Dolittle would be able to stop this monster
now.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp:
「１３枚目だけは、許してぇぇ〜〜〜！　そこ
　が一番いいところなのにぃぃ！」
dialogues.en:
"Page 13, please forgive meee! I hope you're in a better
place nowwww!"
dialogues.text:
"Page 13, please forgive meee! I hope you're in a better
place nowwww!"

dialogues.jp:
なんだかよくわからないことを言いながら、女
の子は、ヤギと格闘している。
dialogues.en:
With confusing screams, the girl continued grappling with
the goat.
dialogues.text:
With confusing screams, the girl continued grappling with
the goat.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp:
「ラストのページだけは、食べないでぇぇ〜！
　せっかく、きれいに描いたんだからぁ！」
dialogues.en: "Don't eat the last pageee! It's my best workkk!"
dialogues.text: "Don't eat the last pageee! It's my best workkk!"

dialogues.jp: このままじゃ、全部食べられてしまいそうだ。
dialogues.en: At this rate, it's going to eat the whole thing.
dialogues.text: At this rate, it's going to eat the whole thing.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、俺があのヤギに向かっていって、勝て
るとも思えない。
dialogues.en: But I don't think I'd be able to win against that... demon.
dialogues.text: But I don't think I'd be able to win against that... demon.

dialogues.jp: 仕方ない……。最後の手段だ。
dialogues.en: I have to try though... my trump card.
dialogues.text: I have to try though... my trump card.

dialogues.jp: これは、あまりやりたくはなかったけど……。
dialogues.en: If this one fails...
dialogues.text: If this one fails...

dialogues.jp: 「おいっ、ヤギッ！」
dialogues.en: "Hey, goat!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, goat!"

dialogues.jp: ヤギは、目だけを俺の方に、ぎろりと向ける。
dialogues.en: The goat suspiciously turned it's gaze towards me.
dialogues.text: The goat suspiciously turned it's gaze towards me.

dialogues.jp: 「ほら、そんな紙より、こっちの方がうまいぞ」
dialogues.en: "C'mon, forget about those papers, this is more delicious."
dialogues.text: "C'mon, forget about those papers, this is more delicious."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、手の中に、和菓子を作り、ヤギに向かっ
て投げる。
dialogues.en:
I made a wagashi appear from my hand, and threw it over the
goat.
dialogues.text:
I made a wagashi appear from my hand, and threw it over the
goat.

dialogues.jp:
みたらしだんご、桜餅、醤油せんべいに、どら
焼き。ついでに、すあまに、きんつばも！
dialogues.en:
Dango, sakuramochi, shouyusenbei, it has all these tastes
rolled into one!
dialogues.text:
Dango, sakuramochi, shouyusenbei, it has all these tastes
rolled into one!

dialogues.jp: どれか一つくらいは食べるに違いない。
dialogues.en: People who taste it certainly know.
dialogues.text: People who taste it certainly know.

dialogues.jp: 「もっとほしけりゃ、もっとやるぞ！」
dialogues.en: "You know you want it more, so go after it!"
dialogues.text: "You know you want it more, so go after it!"

dialogues.jp:
しかし、ヤギはどんな和菓子も、気にせず、女
の子の持っていた紙だけをもっしゃもっしゃと
食べていた。
dialogues.en:
But the goat, completely uninterested in the wagashi,
continued chewing on the last bits of paper remaining.
dialogues.text:
But the goat, completely uninterested in the wagashi,
continued chewing on the last bits of paper remaining.

dialogues.jp: ──そして。
dialogues.en: --And so.
dialogues.text: --And so.

dialogues.jp:
女の子の願いも虚しく、ヤギは最後の１枚を食
べると、べろりと舌なめずりをすると、背を向
けてのそのそと立ち去っていった。
dialogues.en:
Ignoring the vain requests of the girl, the goat swallowed
the final piece, then turned it's back on us and walked
away.
dialogues.text:
Ignoring the vain requests of the girl, the goat swallowed
the final piece, then turned it's back on us and walked
away.

dialogues.jp:
その場には、｛がくぜん／愕然｝とその場に座る女の子だけが
残されていた。
dialogues.en: The flabbergasted girl remained, sitting in solace.
dialogues.text: The flabbergasted girl remained, sitting in solace.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp:
「あうあうあ〜、わ〜た〜し〜の〜愛の結晶が
　あ〜〜〜。ヤギのエサを作るために、徹夜し
　たんじゃないのにぃ〜〜〜」
dialogues.en:
"Waaaaaah~, my work of love~... I didn't make it just to be
goat food~~~"
dialogues.text:
"Waaaaaah~, my work of love~... I didn't make it just to be
goat food~~~"

dialogues.jp:
女の子は、その場でがっくりとうなだれ、半ば
コントのように『よよよよよ〜』と号泣する。
dialogues.en:
The girl, heartbrokenly sitting there, lamented her tale of
woe aloud.
dialogues.text:
The girl, heartbrokenly sitting there, lamented her tale of
woe aloud.

dialogues.jp:
「え、えーと。今ヤギに何か食べられてたみた
　いだけど……」
dialogues.en: "Erm... I guess what the goat just ate was...?'
dialogues.text: "Erm... I guess what the goat just ate was...?'

dialogues.jp: 女の子が、放心状態でこくりと頷く。
dialogues.en: The girl distractedly nodded her head.
dialogues.text: The girl distractedly nodded her head.

dialogues.jp: 「大事なモノだったとか」
dialogues.en: "Something very important, huh..."
dialogues.text: "Something very important, huh..."

dialogues.jp: 女の子は、また頷き、ぼそりと
dialogues.en: The girl continued nodding.
dialogues.text: The girl continued nodding.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「激烈大事なものでした……」
dialogues.en: "Extremely important..."
dialogues.text: "Extremely important..."

dialogues.jp:
どうやら、この子が俺にぶつかった拍子にあの
紙束を落としてしまったらしい。
dialogues.en:
She must've dropped that pile of papers when she crashed
into me from behind.
dialogues.text:
She must've dropped that pile of papers when she crashed
into me from behind.

dialogues.jp:
「よよよよよ〜、またしばらく徹夜だぁ〜。今
　日くらいはぐっすり６時間くらい眠れると思っ
　たのに……」
dialogues.en:
"Waaaaaaah, another all-nighter for me~. I won't be sleeping
till 6 tomorrow..."
dialogues.text:
"Waaaaaaah, another all-nighter for me~. I won't be sleeping
till 6 tomorrow..."

dialogues.jp: （もしかして、俺のせい……かな）
dialogues.en: "(I guess it was my fault...)"
dialogues.text: "(I guess it was my fault...)"

dialogues.jp:
あそこで俺がよそ見をしなければ、彼女はこん
な目に遭わなかったかも知れない。
dialogues.en: I tried not to look straight into her eyes.
dialogues.text: I tried not to look straight into her eyes.

dialogues.jp:
もちろん、前方確認をしていない彼女の方が悪
いに決まってるのだけれど、あれだけ豪快に泣
かれると、俺の方が悪い気分になってくる。
dialogues.en:
Given the way she was crying, I suppose it's almost definite
she blames me as well...
dialogues.text:
Given the way she was crying, I suppose it's almost definite
she blames me as well...

dialogues.jp: 「ほ、ほら、そんなに泣くなよ。なっ？」
dialogues.en: "H, hey, you shouldn't cry over that... right?"
dialogues.text: "H, hey, you shouldn't cry over that... right?"

dialogues.jp:
どう言葉をかけていいのか悩んでいる俺を、う
るうるとした瞳で見上げる。
dialogues.en:
Responding to my worried words, she she lifted her wet eyes
up to look at me.
dialogues.text:
Responding to my worried words, she she lifted her wet eyes
up to look at me.

dialogues.jp: ふと、予鈴のチャイムが聞こえてきた。
dialogues.en:
Of course, the first bell took it's chance to start ringing
right then.
dialogues.text:
Of course, the first bell took it's chance to start ringing
right then.

dialogues.jp: 「ほら、このままじゃ、遅刻するぜ？」
dialogues.en: "See, if we stay like this, we'd be late."
dialogues.text: "See, if we stay like this, we'd be late."

dialogues.jp:
しかし、女の子は、放心状態と涙を繰り返し、
その場にへたり込んだままだった。
dialogues.en:
But the girl's tears continued to flow on the pavement like
twin waterfalls.
dialogues.text:
But the girl's tears continued to flow on the pavement like
twin waterfalls.

dialogues.jp:
まさか、泣いている女の子を放っておけはしな
い。
dialogues.en: Damnit, it's not easy to stop girls from crying.
dialogues.text: Damnit, it's not easy to stop girls from crying.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「ううう……どうしてこんなことに」
dialogues.en: "Uuu... why did this have to happen..."
dialogues.text: "Uuu... why did this have to happen..."

dialogues.jp: 女の子が俺を見る。
dialogues.en: The girl looked at me.
dialogues.text: The girl looked at me.

dialogues.jp: 「悪ぃな。助けてやれなくて」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, I couldn't do anything..."
dialogues.text: "Sorry, I couldn't do anything..."

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp:
「いいえ、あなたは悪くないです。……でも、
　あのお菓子は、どこから？」
dialogues.en:
"No no, it wasn't your fault. ...But, where did that wagashi
come from?"
dialogues.text:
"No no, it wasn't your fault. ...But, where did that wagashi
come from?"

dialogues.jp: ──来た。
dialogues.en: --Here it comes.
dialogues.text: --Here it comes.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、あれだけおおっぴらにやれば、見つかっ
て当たり前だよなぁ。
dialogues.en:
Well, considering how much of a fuss I made about it, of
course she'd have to notice it.
dialogues.text:
Well, considering how much of a fuss I made about it, of
course she'd have to notice it.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp:
「なんだか、手からポコポコ出てたみたいでし
　たけど……」
dialogues.en: "It just sort of magically appeared from your hand..."
dialogues.text: "It just sort of magically appeared from your hand..."

dialogues.jp: 適当にごまかせば、ごまかすほど怪しいな。
dialogues.en:
There's no way I can think of to hide it, and she'd be
suspicious anyway.
dialogues.text:
There's no way I can think of to hide it, and she'd be
suspicious anyway.

dialogues.jp: 仕方ない。
dialogues.en: What's done is done.
dialogues.text: What's done is done.

dialogues.jp:
「実は、俺は手から和菓子を生み出す力を持っ
　ているんだ」
dialogues.en:
"The truth is, I have some power that allows me to produce
wagashi from my hand."
dialogues.text:
"The truth is, I have some power that allows me to produce
wagashi from my hand."

dialogues.jp: なんだか、言っててバカバカしいぞ。
dialogues.en: Hah, it sounds so stupid when I say it.
dialogues.text: Hah, it sounds so stupid when I say it.

dialogues.jp:
とりあえず、俺は手のひらの中に、おはぎを作っ
て見せる。
dialogues.en:
Just to confirm it for her, I open up my hand and produce
another one.
dialogues.text:
Just to confirm it for her, I open up my hand and produce
another one.

dialogues.jp:
「……悪いけど、このことは誰にも言わないで
　くれないか？」
dialogues.en: "...Sorry, but could you not tell anyone about this?"
dialogues.text: "...Sorry, but could you not tell anyone about this?"

dialogues.jp: 「そうだ」

「君がヤギに食べられたものは、何かはよくわ
　からないけど、やり直しが利くのか？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, right!"
dialogues.text: "Oh, right!"

dialogues.jp:
「はい……、さっきの原稿……げふげふん、今
　の書類は、書き直せば……」
dialogues.en:
"I don't know exactly what the goat ate, but you'd have to
make a copy of it, right?"
dialogues.text:
"I don't know exactly what the goat ate, but you'd have to
make a copy of it, right?"

dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、俺は、秘密を黙ってもらう代わりに
　俺が責任もって手伝うよ。何かできることが
　あったら、なんでもする」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah... that was a copy, but I'd have to write out another
one now..."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah... that was a copy, but I'd have to write out another
one now..."

dialogues.jp:
「だから、さっきのことは誰にも言わないでく
　れ……」
dialogues.en:
"In that case, in return for keeping quiet about my secret,
I'd take over that for you. As long as I'm able to do it,
that is."
dialogues.text:
"In that case, in return for keeping quiet about my secret,
I'd take over that for you. As long as I'm able to do it,
that is."

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp:
「べ、別に、交換条件にしなくても……あたし
　は言いませんよ。安心してください」
dialogues.en: "So please, don't tell that to anyone..."
dialogues.text: "So please, don't tell that to anyone..."

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp:
「そうか……。でも、どっちにしても、今回の
　ことは俺がよそ見をしたのが悪いんだ。やっ
　ぱり手伝うよ」
dialogues.en:
"Y, you don't have to use that to bargain... I won't tell
anyone, don't worry."
dialogues.text:
"Y, you don't have to use that to bargain... I won't tell
anyone, don't worry."

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp:
「それは……でも、……えっと、本当に手伝っ
　てもらえるんですか？」
dialogues.en:
"Alright... but I still feel that I've some fault in this.
In the end, I should help anyway."
dialogues.text:
"Alright... but I still feel that I've some fault in this.
In the end, I should help anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp:
「約束する。だから、そろそろ立ってくれ。こ
　のままじゃふたりとも遅刻になる」
dialogues.en: "That is... but... well, you really will help?"
dialogues.text: "That is... but... well, you really will help?"

dialogues.jp:
いつの間にか、時間は遅刻ギリギリになってい
た。
dialogues.en:
"That's a promise. Both ways, we shouldn't just stand here,
we'd be REALLY late at this point."
dialogues.text:
"That's a promise. Both ways, we shouldn't just stand here,
we'd be REALLY late at this point."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、まだ名前も聞いていない女の子と一緒に
校舎目指して、走った。
dialogues.en: We could just make it in time if we move now.
dialogues.text: We could just make it in time if we move now.

dialogues.jp: 「どうやら、間に合いそうだ……」
dialogues.en:
I walked to the school building with the girl whose name I
still haven't heard.
dialogues.text:
I walked to the school building with the girl whose name I
still haven't heard.

dialogues.jp:
３年の教室棟に到着し、とりあえず、一安心っ
てところか。
dialogues.en: "Looks like we made it..."
dialogues.text: "Looks like we made it..."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、とりあえず女の子の名前を聞くことにし
た。
dialogues.en:
As we reached the section for third-years, a sense of relief
overcame us.
dialogues.text:
As we reached the section for third-years, a sense of relief
overcame us.

dialogues.jp: 「埼玉さん？」
dialogues.en: I finally ask for the girl's name.
dialogues.text: I finally ask for the girl's name.

dialogues.jp:
「彩る珠で、さいたま、ね。俺はてっきり、埼
　玉県の……」
dialogues.en: "Saitama-san?"
dialogues.text: "Saitama-san?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「ななこでいいです！　あたしのことは、な・
　な・こ、と呼んでください！」
dialogues.en: "Saitama. Saitama Nanako."
dialogues.text: "Saitama. Saitama Nanako."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.en: "Nanako is fine! Please call me Nanako from now on!"
dialogues.text: "Nanako is fine! Please call me Nanako from now on!"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「あたし、苗字で呼ばれるの、苦手なんです」
dialogues.en: "I'd rather not be called by my surname..."
dialogues.text: "I'd rather not be called by my surname..."

dialogues.jp: なんとなく、微妙にわかる気がする……。
dialogues.en: Hm, looks like that's a touchy subject...
dialogues.text: Hm, looks like that's a touchy subject...

dialogues.jp: 「でも、呼び捨てっていうのは」
dialogues.en: "But I should be calling you by your last name."
dialogues.text: "But I should be calling you by your last name."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「えーと、実は、その方が落ち着けていいって
　いうか、普段親からとかもそう呼ばれてるか
　らとか……」
dialogues.en:
"Well, everyone calls me that by now, including my parents,
so..."
dialogues.text:
"Well, everyone calls me that by now, including my parents,
so..."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、そっちの方がいいって言うなら、俺は
　構わないんだけどさ」
dialogues.en: "Oh well, if you want me to, I have no problems with it."
dialogues.text: "Oh well, if you want me to, I have no problems with it."

dialogues.jp:
会ってすぐ呼び捨てってのが、ちょっと抵抗あ
るだけで、俺自身呼び捨てにしてる女の子は結
構いるから、実はどうでもいい。
dialogues.en:
I'd probably be happier to be calling a girl by her first
name anyway.
dialogues.text:
I'd probably be happier to be calling a girl by her first
name anyway.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、そうだ、俺は１組の朝倉[name]」
dialogues.en: "Oh, right. I'm from Class 1, Asakura [name]."
dialogues.text: "Oh, right. I'm from Class 1, Asakura [name]."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉……くんですか。私は３組なので、この
　先です」
dialogues.en:
"Asakura...kun, then. I'm from Class 3, and I'd be heading
there now."
dialogues.text:
"Asakura...kun, then. I'm from Class 3, and I'd be heading
there now."

dialogues.jp:
ななこは、そう言ってにっこりと笑い、俺の教
室のちょっと先を指さした。
dialogues.en:
Nanako giggled a little and started heading in the direction
of her class, behind me.
dialogues.text:
Nanako giggled a little and started heading in the direction
of her class, behind me.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「それでは、また。どうもありがとうございま
　した」
dialogues.en: "I'd see you again. Thank you very much for your help."
dialogues.text: "I'd see you again. Thank you very much for your help."

dialogues.jp:
俺とななこは廊下で別れ、それぞれの教室に飛
びこんだ。
dialogues.en:
We seperated at the corridor, and went to our respective
classrooms.
dialogues.text:
We seperated at the corridor, and went to our respective
classrooms.

dialogues.jp:
担任の暦先生が現れたのはそれから３０秒後だっ
た。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei came just 30 seconds after me.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei came just 30 seconds after me.

dialogues.jp: ふーっ、ぎりぎりセーフ。
dialogues.en: Whew, just about saved.
dialogues.text: Whew, just about saved.

dialogues.jp: ◆ななことヤギ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Nanako and the goat◆
dialogues.text: ◆Nanako and the goat◆

dialogues.jp: 遅刻寸前の登校途中、なぜかヤギがいた。
dialogues.en:
On the verge of lateness, I saw a goat in front of the
school.
dialogues.text:
On the verge of lateness, I saw a goat in front of the
school.

dialogues.jp:
つい、そのヤギに気を取られていると、後ろか
らやってきた女の子にぶつかられ、転倒してし
まった。
dialogues.en:
With the goat attracting my attention, a girl crashed into
me from behind.
dialogues.text:
With the goat attracting my attention, a girl crashed into
me from behind.

dialogues.jp:
女の子は転んだ拍子に、持っていた書類のよう
なものをヤギに食べられているらしく大騒ぎし
ていた。
dialogues.en:
When she tumbled over, she dropped a manuscript which the
goat gobbled down.
dialogues.text:
When she tumbled over, she dropped a manuscript which the
goat gobbled down.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、和菓子の力で応戦するが、とても叶わず
女の子は書類を食べられ、ひどく落ち込んでし
まうのだった。
dialogues.en:
I tried to distract the goat by creating a wagashi to
distract it, but it was all in vain.
dialogues.text:
I tried to distract the goat by creating a wagashi to
distract it, but it was all in vain.

dialogues.jp:
和菓子の力を見られたこともあって、俺はその
子に、書類を作り直すための手伝いをしようと
約束する。
dialogues.en:
Since she saw my power, I promised to help her with her
manuscript as long as she kept my power a secret.
dialogues.text:
Since she saw my power, I promised to help her with her
manuscript as long as she kept my power a secret.

dialogues.jp:
女の子は、名前を彩珠ななこと言いどうやら同
級生のようだった。俺は、なんとも不思議な子
と知り合いになったのだった。
dialogues.en:
The girl's name was Nanako, and we were in the same year.
Yet another strange girl in my acquaintance list.
dialogues.text:
The girl's name was Nanako, and we were in the same year.
Yet another strange girl in my acquaintance list.
